scope: Tanjiro six-slot behavior and versioned authoring; original presentation and publication remain unverified

mechanisms.PASSIVE: Independent six-stack breath resets each round. A real nearby defender evasion gives an owned two-second opening that reveals that enemy. Only a connected Q/W/R knife hit consumes that caster opening, at most once per cast; basic and derived damage do not consume it.
mechanisms.Q: One frontal 120-degree radius-three arc after 0.2s startup. Both water and fire cost one breath. Fire deals higher physical damage but gives two-second movement burden, -8% per stack up to three. Actual stance selects ice/wind or fire VFX.
mechanisms.W: Forward collision-safe movement up to three units after 0.15s startup, damaging each encountered enemy once. Costs one breath.
mechanisms.E: Three-second breathing restores at a base half-second rate, with an additional payout after real continuous stillness and no recent connected damage. Movement, HP damage and shield damage lower recovery. Six-stack cap, expiry, death and round reset are tested; no extra mana restoration.
mechanisms.R: One frontal slash after interruptible 0.65s startup. Three breath and ordinary mana/cooldown are reserved on cast; interruption does not refund. Resolved slash adds burden.
mechanisms.EX: Free water/fire toggle preserves the actual Q instance, cooldown, mana, breath and old burden. Round reset returns to water.

adaptation.reason: Owner explicitly permits funny simplified kits using existing templates and mechanics, with no new engine features.
adaptation.difference: Original higher fire breath cost becomes the same one-breath cost; higher fire damage instead trades movement speed.
adaptation.withdrawn: The unpushed v1 conditional-cost helper/schema and empty consumeStatus extension are removed in the final source tree. Revision 13 was not published; v2 produces revision 14.

presentationChanges: Q uses actual stance-conditioned existing ice/wind or fire VFX instead of a fixed target beam.
W pulse follows the caster rather than an unrelated point.
R uses orange fire slash/pulse instead of a blue-tinted beam.
EX removes its unconditional ice overlay; its real stance toggle supplies ice/fire cues.

limitations: Existing bound Tanjiro model is retained, with hurt using idle as previously recorded. Dedicated waterwheel pose, sword trails and sound have not passed a new visual review.
VFX event and stance selection are tested; this is not a rendered-frame or visual-quality verdict.
Current-service ZIP, submission, admin review and formal publication for the corrected kit are not yet completed.
Batch-wide creative redesign, causal diversity review and the remaining 129 unmapped slots remain unfinished.
